rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for a substance added to another substance or product to give it particular properties.

example.english: This sausage contains no additive, so I feel safer eating it.
example.traditional: 呢款香腸冇添加劑，食得安心啲。
example.jyutping: ne1 fun2 hoeng1 coeng2 mou5 tim1 gaa1 zai1 sik6 dak1 on1 sam1 di1
